independent_measurement.fixture: Temporary index populated through git update-index -z --index-info; indexed UTF-8 names include literal * and ? without requiring Windows worktree files. Attributes read back with git check-attr -z.
independent_measurement.limitations: Most escape requests use top magic to preserve raw pattern bytes on Windows. This is not a claim to have executed native POSIX Git. Case 08 exact non-top POSIX argv still needs Linux verification.
